r0hzdv0f.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Mini Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
r0hzdv0f.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Mini Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
r0hzdv0f.sourceDescription: This unique and contemporary decorative piece features a modern cone shape and is crafted primarily for both indoor and outdoor use. The design aligns perfectly with the Christmas season, where its textured PVC finish and elegant green hue contribute to a festive atmosphere, whether in your living room or on the garden terrace. Textured Cone Design This decorative piece flaunts a cone-shaped structure that elevates any setting with its intricate textures and striking elegance. Designed for ultimate visual appeal, its unique form captivates, providing an aesthetically pleasing focal point in both living rooms and garden spaces. Decorative String Lights Adorned with strands of decorative string lights, this item transforms spaces with its glow. These lights are specially crafted for festive occasions, lending an enchanting ambiance to every corner they grace, seamlessly transitioning between daytime decor and evening illumination. LED Warmth The built-in LED light source emits a warm white hue, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere irrespective of the location. With LEDs known for their energy efficiency and lasting lifespan, enjoy a consistent and pleasant luminescence throughout the celebration season. Versatile Usage Perfect for indoor and outdoor settings, this piece seamlessly adapts to diverse environments. Whether nestled amidst living room decor or poised elegantly on a garden terrace, it merges effortlessly with its surroundings, boosting festive cheer everywhere. Simple Assembly Required While assembly is required, the process is straightforward and can be completed by two people. Every component comes with clear instructions, ensuring each piece fits perfectly, so you can quickly enjoy a charming seasonal display without hassle. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 90 cm Stand size: 40 cm Durable Decorate with cones Lifelike branch tips with frosted snow Number of pine cones: 12 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1xChristmastree,1xLEDstringlight,1xPeak,40x6cmball,40x4cmball,40x3cmball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

g56nry2q.variantName: Christmas Tree World 3ft Celestara Fibre Optic Tree - Warm White
g56nry2q.sourceDescription: The 3ft Celestara Fibre Optic Christmas Tree features green artificial foliage with 80 branch tips arranged across a compact diameter of approximately 45cm. Integrated warm white fibre optics and starburst-style lighting clusters provide illumination with 13 selectable lighting settings. The lighting system operates silently without moving mechanical components. Attached branches form the main tree structure, while a 1.85m mains power lead supplies the lighting. The tree has certified fire-retardant foliage and is designed for indoor use. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

w529y8jv.baseName: HOMCOM 8ft Christmas Inflatable Santa Claus on Sleigh - Yellow
w529y8jv.variantName: HOMCOM 8ft Christmas Inflatable Santa Claus on Sleigh - Yellow
w529y8jv.sourceDescription: Create the ultimate festive Christmas display in your yard this holiday season with HOMCOM' Christmas decoration. Designed with ultra-durable, weather-resistant polyester cloth and featuring internal LED light, it will invoke the holiday spirit for years to come. Automatically inflating after power-on creates a super simple set-up process that anyone can do. Build the perfect holiday yard display this year to outdo the neighbours and bring holiday cheer in classic Christmas fashion. ● The fashionable design with images including Santa Claus and deer creates a festival atmosphere ● 6 B2 LED light in the internal deer, gift bag and Santa Claus brings a vibrant effect and enhances visibility at night ● Automatically inflate after power-on for easy setup ● 6 ground stakes, 2 drawstrings and 4 sandbags ensure the stability and sturdy standing ● The air can be drained for easy storage ● Weather-resistant polyester cloth, certification: IP44, ideal for indoor and outdoors use Colour: Yellow, Red Type: Inflatable Santa Claus on Sleigh with Two Deer Material: Polyester Cloth Overall Dimension: 240W x 57D x 112Hcm Power Cable Length: 2m LED Light Power: 0.48W Fan: DC 12V/1.0A Input voltage: 220-240V/50HZ Output voltage: DC 12V/1.25A Certification: IP44, UKCA, CE-EMC, RoHS Item Label: 844-372V70 NOTE 1: Ensure air blower is always connected to keep decoration inflated 2: Please don't place it outdoor in hard rain or snow! Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
